purpose: Evaluate reconstructed bill authorship as a zero-weight component of the single quick-evidence-v1 candidate using official dated Revisor provenance.

source.system: Minnesota Revisor Bill Status API v1
source.identityPolicy: session/chamber roster resolution must be unique; unresolved or ambiguous names make the bill ineligible

asOfPolicy.reconstruction: start from current resolved authors and reverse dated add/strike actions on or after the target date
asOfPolicy.reason: historical Revisor actions are date-granular and do not prove ordering within a day

fit.model: single ridge logistic offset on serving Quick logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error
